summary: Recognizable Norton Hall caricature with the correct long auditorium mass, raised stage block, pale masonry, five-arch ceremonial front, and broad stairs. The principal silhouette is weakened by the conspicuously pitched-looking gray roof and an overly simplified entrance façade.

orientation.summary: The geolocated SV1 camera faces the +u side and directly shows the five-arched principal entrance; the labeled +u render places all five entrance portals there. The actual inventory confirms five arches only on +u, with a single secondary double door on -v and one service door on -u, so there is no duplicated principal portal. SV2/SV4 are consistent with those secondary/rear placements.

issues.problem: The auditorium reads as having a vast gray sloping roof, while the aerial and street views show a pale, nearly flat roof concealed by parapets. This changes the characteristic silhouette.
issues.fix: Flatten and lighten the main roof, keeping only subtle drainage slope, and strengthen the perimeter parapet/coping.

issues.problem: The principal façade is too plain: its corner relief panels, arched surrounds, slender decorative piers, and upper inscription band are weak or reduced to generic shapes.
issues.fix: Exaggerate these few signature ornaments with shallow relief and stronger contrast while retaining the miniature style.
